inputs.name: server
inputs.description: One k3s server to run istioctl on: an address, or a host object with an address and optional host_key, user, port, private_key_file or jump_hosts.

inputs.name: istio_version
inputs.description: Istio release, without a v. Change it with checksums and k3s_minors.

inputs.name: checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the istioctl tarball for each architecture, from the .sha256 file beside it on the Istio release.

inputs.name: k3s_minors
inputs.description: Kubernetes minor versions the server's k3s may run, from Istio's supported releases page. Anything else fails the apply before Istio is touched.

inputs.name: ingress_gateway
inputs.description: Install Istio's ingress gateway too, which is its default profile rather than minimal. It wants ports 80 and 443, so Traefik must be disabled on circuit-k3s first.

inputs.name: inject_namespaces
inputs.description: Namespaces to create if they're missing and label for sidecar injection. Pods already running there get a sidecar when they're next restarted.

inputs.name: operator_spec
inputs.description: More fields for the spec of the IstioOperator file, such as { meshConfig = { accessLogFile = "/dev/stdout" } }. Keys here replace the same keys from this circuit, profile included. They reach state, so nothing secret goes here.
